analysis_kind: Post-run descriptive outcome analysis; no new behavior success thresholds or simulation

recorded_paired_mechanism.interpretation: Afferent-output block can change physical feedback and later input/RNG assignment. A matched-prefix downstream difference supports graph transmission, not natural navigation.

stage_clocks.host_physiology_clock_note: No independent elapsed physiology clock is exposed. A partial native step may not update physiology; do not infer its clock from native or observation time.

endpoint_voltage.endpoint_scope: Saved state before cleanup; not trajectory-wide or within-tick extrema
endpoint_voltage.identity_method: Hash-verified neuron_ids.npy order equals neurons.feather bodyId row order; checkpoint graph identity and parameter metadata equal frozen plan
endpoint_voltage.source_definition: IDs actually listed in journal neural_start drives, including zero-rate members; probe category only when actually appended in motor_probe assay
endpoint_voltage.transmitter_caveat: Consensus NT labels describe each cell's predicted output transmitter; they do not identify which incoming currents caused its voltage
